_comment: Workstream G regression KAT: a real deposit proof's B (G2) point, captured from a live e2e run whose TS compressProof() got the sign-flag bit wrong (compared the Fq2 coordinate halves in the wrong priority order) and was rejected on-chain by the real Sunspot verifier with "Proof verification failed!" even though decompression itself succeeded. The single-proof KAT in proof_compression_kat.json did not catch this because its B point's second serialized half happened to tie its own negation (y1 == -y1), which made the (wrong) primary-comparison choice irrelevant there. Ground truth (both the uncompressed and correctly-compressed bytes) was computed with solana_bn254's real Rust compression, independently of this repo's TS port.
